user_saw: Guests with only session scopes could select a registered project in New Session, but the New worktree option never appeared.
summary: New Session now offers managed worktrees for registered projects whose host paths are withheld and lets the Gateway validate the checkout using the project ID.
reasoning: The registered-project picker had long treated a selection without a repoRoot as idle, while project listings disclosed host paths to callers with broad write access. I checked that #155184 added projects.list to the session-read scope while retaining path redaction, exposing the existing picker assumption to guests whose session-write scope already admitted sessions.create. The fix PR confirmed that a guest could create the managed worktree by project ID through the Gateway even while the UI hid the option.
